channel.title: Slate & Signal
channel.description: Brand discovery and clarity for people at the very beginning of building a personal brand.

item.title: How Do I Pick a Niche When I Have So Many Interests?
item.description: Choosing a niche when you have a lot of interests does not have to mean abandoning most of them. Look for the common thread, the angle, and the room where your interests already make sense together.

item.title: You Followed the Personal Branding Advice. So Why Isn't It Working?
item.description: You did what the experts said and very little happened. The steps are not wrong. They just leave out the decisions underneath them.

item.title: The Question Nobody Can Answer
item.description: Every branding guide asks what you want to be known for, then moves on as though you already know. Here's a real place to begin when you don't.

item.title: What a Personal Brand Is: ACTUALLY
item.description: You already have a personal brand. Building a business simply means learning how to translate it.

item.title: The Personal Branding Problem
item.description: Why building a personal brand feels so confusing, and where the real starting point actually is.
